name: Facial-Attribute-Detection
headline: Comprehensive facial analysis by extracting face features.
description: Detects attributes (eye closeness, mask presence, eyeglasses presence, sunglasses presence) that apply to a given face. This model's architecture was developed by Qualcomm. The model was trained by Qualcomm on a proprietary dataset of faces, but can be used on any image.
applicable_scenarios: Incabinet driver monitoring, phone unlocking, and building access control.
